method: Conservative major-key membership screen, then the score ribbon's segmental chord analysis for stages. Saved/local-major tonics, reviewed constraints and sparse bass/power chords retain priority; sidecars require matching MIDI hash, annotation settings and harmony version. Insufficient segmental coverage retains the legacy estimate with an explicit fallback. No model fitting or curated corpus membership changes.
